text:
miriam: Need to tighten RBAC for onprem keystore-sync: only Rotate/Describe/Export-checks. No Decrypt. Also need compliance proof that app pods never egress to KMS directly. Suggestions?
aj: Build a KMS-proxy sidecar pattern. Proxy holds KMS creds, enforces operation ACLs by service identity, and does mTLS inbound/outbound. Apps talk only to proxy svc.
sam_k: Netpol: deny-all egress in app namespace, allow egress from sync pods only to podSelector app=keystore-proxy on TCP/8443. Proxy has separate netpol to allow egress to specific control-plane KMS IPs. Enforce hostNetwork=false and runAsNonRoot. Example minimal NP provided.
sec-bot: SCAN NOTE: keystore-client v1.2.3 flagged (CVE-2025-0100) affecting export API. Recommend upgrade to 1.2.5 or patch. https://sec.example/cve/CVE-2025-0100
olivia: SIEM fields: ts, req_id, principal (svc), operation (Encrypt/Decrypt/Rotate/Export), key_id, outcome(ALLOW/DENY), proxy_out_ip, vpc_id, tenant_id, trace_hash. Use structured JSON logs. Provide short human message for oncall.
miriam: For audit proof, we need tamper-evident evidence that app pods never talked to non-proxy IPs. How?
aj: Proxy should log outbound IP + peer cert fingerprint per request and publish signed log anchors to customer audit buckets. Optionally keep short pcaps on proxy egress interface and store HMAC digest (sensitive).
sam_k: Add eBPF conntrack read-only telemetry on nodes to show no external connections from app pods. Provide redacted export for auditors.
dinesh: Incident playbook (summary): 1) apply KMS deny policy on affected key(s) 2) revoke keystore-sync SA tokens 3) rotate & rewrap keys 4) spin up emergency local keystore if needed 5) collect forensic bundle (proxy logs, kube-audit, netpol traces) 6) notify customers per SLA. Keep commands scriptable.
miriam: Want canary rollout: enable proxy with Decrypt denied in ~5% clusters; monitor logs for any ALLOW-Decrypt or spiky DENY rates; auto rollback if anomaly. Implementation suggestions?
aj: Use label-based canary (proxy.canary=true) and route a subset of clusters/nodepools to that helm value. Alert on log rule: op=="Decrypt" && outcome=="ALLOW"; and DENY-rate > 5x baseline over 10m.
olivia: For privacy, use trace_hash = HMAC(request_id + secret) instead of full request. Rotate HMAC key monthly and store in keystore.
sam_k: Pre-deploy checklist: pinned & scanned proxy image, netpols applied, egress gateway IPs validated, eBPF + proxy logs enabled, SIEM mapping, canary clusters ready, runbook in vault.
miriam: I'll open a PR with key-scoped RBAC binding, proxy helm chart + canary values, SIEM mapping, and runbook snippet. Ping for review. :thumbsup:
